about: Every pack under public/art: what loads it, what rebuilds it, and whether it can be regenerated. Below that, the role of every folder in assets/generated. scripts/art-packs.test.mjs checks that each pack and folder is listed here, that the listed paths exist, and that loadedBy matches src. Statuses were read from the scripts on 2026-11-22; `checked` says which builds were actually rerun. `mastersDiffer` counts the shipped files whose pixels are not their PNG master's (measured 2026-11-22): see gifEra.

statuses.regenerate: A batch script paints new takes with Codex, and the build turns the chosen takes into what ships.
statuses.rebuild: Sources and a build script in git rebuild what ships. New art means new sources, and usually new crop boxes.
statuses.broken: A build script exists, but it reads inputs that are gone (mostly GIFs and PNGs in public/ that ship as WebP since 8d17e2f).
statuses.sources-only: The generated sources and crop boxes are in git, but no script turns them into what ships.
statuses.frozen: Only the shipped files and their PNG masters exist. To change it, make a new pack.
statuses.preview: Loaded only by the art preview page (sprite-preview.html), not by the game.

after: list new files in scripts/runtime-art.json (or the pack in LAZY_PACKS)
the pack's checks, then npm test

gifEra: e0b819f shipped most art as GIF and kept each full-colour original as its master in assets/art-masters; 8d17e2f then shipped the GIF pixels as WebP. So in the packs with mastersDiffer, the master is the original (more colours, soft alpha) and players see its GIF reduction (on/off alpha, at most 256 colours). convert-art-webp keeps applying that reduction (scripts/art-quantise.mjs) to every file marked quantised in webp.json, and to files new to these packs unless they are glass or mostly soft, so a rebuild ships what shipped before. scripts/art-quantise.test.mjs checks the reduction still reproduces the shipped pixels.
